row_rules.R1_pnl_sentinel: ABS(pnl_pct) >= 999999 (clamp value from a blown-up PnL calc)
row_rules.R5_magnitude: ABS(pnl_pct) > 1000 (>10x move in one trade = scale corruption)
row_rules.R6_stop_out_no_stop: labelled SL_HIT while the stop sat on the wrong side of entry
row_rules.R7_scale_vs_ohlcv: |pnl|>50% row whose entry/exit is >2x off the real close on its own date

bracket_rules.B1_bad_stop: stop on the wrong side of entry -> stop_loss NULLed
bracket_rules.B2_bad_take_profit: take_profit on the wrong side of entry -> take_profit NULLed
bracket_rules.B3_bracket_scale: bracket more than 100x from entry -> that field NULLed
